source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Unit 1 (PDF 3-35), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 1 (Graphical Representation of Functions) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.
1.1 Graph of Quadratic Function Using Factors

blocks.prompt:
1 Find the x-intercepts and the vertex of \(y = 2(x + 1)(x - 5)\).
(\(y = 2(x + 1)(x - 5)\) ke x-intercepts aur vertex maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: The graph will cut the x-axis at

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the y-intercept of \(y = -3(x - 2)(x + 4)\).
(\(y = -3(x - 2)(x + 4)\) ka y-intercept maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 0\) rakhein: \(y = -3(-2)(4) = 24\). Graph y-axis ko \((0, 24)\) par kaatta hai.

book_ref.quote: the graph will cut the y-axis at

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the behaviour of \(y = -(x - 1)(x - 6)\) as \(x \to \pm\infty\). Does it open upward or downward?
(\(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y = -(x - 1)(x - 6)\) ka rawayya batayein. Yeh ooper khulta hai ya neeche?)
blocks.explanation: Yahan \(a = -1 < 0\), is liye dono taraf \(y \to -\infty\). Parabola neeche khulta hai.

book_ref.quote: Determine the behaviour of

blocks.prompt:
4 Where does the graph of \(y = -2(x + 3)^{2}\) meet the x-axis? Give its vertex and the direction of opening.
(\(y = -2(x + 3)^{2}\) ka graph x-axis ko kahan milta hai? Vertex aur khulne ki simt batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dohraya factor: graph x-axis ko sirf \(x = -3\) par chhoota hai, vertex \((-3, 0)\). \(a = -2 < 0\): neeche khulta hai.

book_ref.quote: then the function becomes

blocks.prompt:
5 Factorize \(y = x^{2} - 2x - 8\) and find its x-intercepts and vertex.
(\(y = x^{2} - 2x - 8\) ko factorize kar ke x-intercepts aur vertex maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Suppose, after factorizing

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the behaviour of \(y = -(x + 1)(x - 2)(x - 4)\) as \(x \to -\infty\) and \(x \to +\infty\).
(\(y = -(x + 1)(x - 2)(x - 4)\) ka \(x \to -\infty\) aur \(x \to +\infty\) par rawayya batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Daayen teenon factors positive, \(a = -1\): \(x \to +\infty\) par \(y \to -\infty\). Baayen teen negatives ka product negative, \(-1\) se zarb positive: \(x \to -\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\).

book_ref.quote: then what will be the behaviour of

blocks.text: 1.2 Predicting a Quadratic Function from its Graph

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the quadratic function whose graph has x-intercepts \(3\) and \(-2\) and passes through \((1, 12)\).
(Woh quadratic function maloom karein jis ke graph ke x-intercepts \(3\) aur \(-2\) hain aur jo \((1, 12)\) se guzarta hai.)

book_ref.quote: To find \(a\), substitute the coordinates of a third known point into the equation.

blocks.prompt:
8 A parabola touches the x-axis at \(x = -3\) and passes through \((-1, 8)\). Find its equation.
(Aik parabola x-axis ko \(x = -3\) par chhoota hai aur \((-1, 8)\) se guzarta hai. Is ki equation (muadla) maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: If the graph only touches the x-axis at

blocks.prompt:
9 Why are the two x-intercepts not enough to find a quadratic function? What else is needed?
(Sirf do x-intercepts se quadratic function kyun nahi milta? Aur kya chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Intercepts sirf factors dete hain: har \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) ke intercepts same hain. \(a\) ke liye graph ka aik aur point (x-axis se bahar) chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Why is a third point needed?

blocks.prompt:
10 Define an algebraic function in simple words and give two examples.
(Algebraic function ki aasaan alfaaz mein definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Function \(y = f(x)\) algebraic hai agar yeh \(x\) se mehdood algebraic operations (jama, tafreeq, zarb, taqseem aur \(n^{\text{th}}\) roots) se bane. Misalein: \(x^{3} - 4x\), \(\sqrt{x + 7}\).

book_ref.quote: In simple words, a function

blocks.prompt:
11 Show that \(y = \dfrac{2x + 1}{x^{2} + 3}\) is an algebraic function.
(Dikhayein ke \(y = \dfrac{2x + 1}{x^{2} + 3}\) algebraic function hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 3\) se zarb: \((x^{2} + 3)y - (2x + 1) = 0\). Yeh \(y\) mein polynomial equation hai, is liye function algebraic hai.

book_ref.quote: where each \(P_{i}(x)\) is a polynomial in \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
12 Write the polynomial equation satisfied by \(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 4}\). Is the function algebraic?
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x - 4}\) jis polynomial equation ko satisfy karta hai woh likhein. Kya function algebraic hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf cube: \(y^{3} - (x - 4) = 0\). Polynomial equation hai, is liye algebraic.

book_ref.quote: So roots and fractions do not make a function transcendental.

blocks.prompt:
13 Classify as algebraic or transcendental: \(x^{3} - 4x\), \(3^{x}\), \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 5}\), \(\ln(x + 2)\).
(Algebraic ya transcendental batayein: \(x^{3} - 4x\), \(3^{x}\), \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 5}\), \(\ln(x + 2)\).)
blocks.explanation: Algebraic: \(x^{3} - 4x\), \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 5}\). Transcendental: \(3^{x}\) (\(x\) exponent mein), \(\ln(x + 2)\) (\(x\) log ke andar).

book_ref.quote: To classify a function, look for

blocks.prompt:
14 What are fundamental transcendental functions? Give three examples.
(Fundamental transcendental functions kya hain? Teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aam istemal hone wale standard transcendental functions hain jin se mushkil functions bante hain, maslan \(y = 7^{x}\), \(y = \ln x\), \(y = \cos^{-1} x\).

book_ref.quote: Fundamental transcendental functions are the commonly used standard transcendental functions

blocks.prompt:
15 Why are \(y = 1^{x}\) and \(y = (-4)^{x}\) not exponential functions?
(\(y = 1^{x}\) aur \(y = (-4)^{x}\) exponential functions kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(1^{x} = 1\) har \(x\) par: constant. \((-4)^{1/2} = \sqrt{-4}\) real nahi. Base \(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\) hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: So only a positive base other than 1 gives a genuine exponential function.

blocks.prompt:
16 Is \(y = 25^{x/2}\) a fundamental transcendental function? Is \(y = e^{x^{3}}\)?
(Kya \(y = 25^{x/2}\) fundamental transcendental function hai? Aur \(y = e^{x^{3}}\)?)
blocks.explanation: \(25^{x/2} = 5^{x}\): fundamental. \(e^{x^{3}}\) mein exponent \(x^{3}\) (composition), is liye non-fundamental.

book_ref.quote: Before deciding "non-fundamental", always try to rewrite the function as one standard function.

blocks.prompt:
17 Classify as fundamental or non-fundamental transcendental: \(\sin^{-1} x\), \(\sin x + x\), \(4^{x}\), \(\ln(x^{2} + 1)\).
(Fundamental ya non-fundamental transcendental batayein: \(\sin^{-1} x\), \(\sin x + x\), \(4^{x}\), \(\ln(x^{2} + 1)\).)
blocks.explanation: Fundamental: \(\sin^{-1} x\), \(4^{x}\). Non-fundamental: \(\sin x + x\) (algebraic ke saath jama), \(\ln(x^{2} + 1)\) (composition).

book_ref.quote: Functions formed by combining transcendental functions with algebraic functions

blocks.prompt:
18 Define the exponential function and the natural exponential function.
(Exponential function aur natural exponential function ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = a^{x}\), \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), \(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\): exponential function, base \(a\). \(f(x) = e^{x}\) natural exponential function hai, jahan \(e = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n!} \approx 2.71828\).

book_ref.quote: is called an exponential function

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the sum of the first six terms of \(e = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n!}\).
(\(e = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n!}\) ke pehle chhe terms ka majmua maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: and its approximate value is

blocks.prompt:
20 Which of \(y = 3^{x}\) and \(y = \left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^{x}\) represents growth and which decay? Why?
(\(y = 3^{x}\) aur \(y = \left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^{x}\) mein kaun growth aur kaun decay hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: \(3^{x}\): base \(3 > 1\), growth. \(\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^{x}\): base 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan, decay.

book_ref.quote: represent exponential growth, while the function

blocks.prompt:
21 Make a table of values of \(y = 4^{x}\) for \(x = -2, -1, 0, 1, 2\) and state its y-intercept.
(\(y = 4^{x}\) ki \(x = -2, -1, 0, 1, 2\) ke liye table banayein aur y-intercept batayein.)

book_ref.quote: Make a short table of values

blocks.prompt:
22 State the domain, range, y-intercept and asymptote of \(y = 7^{x}\).
(\(y = 7^{x}\) ka domain, range, y-intercept aur asymptote batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \(]-\infty, \infty[\); range \(]0, \infty[\); y-intercept \((0, 1)\); horizontal asymptote \(y = 0\) (\(x \to -\infty\) par).

book_ref.quote: the domain of the exponential function is

blocks.prompt:
23 Evaluate \(16^{-3/4}\) and show that it is positive, as the positivity property says.
(\(16^{-3/4}\) nikalein aur dikhayein ke yeh positive hai.)

book_ref.quote: root of a positive number is also positive

blocks.prompt:
24 Is \(y = (0.8)^{x}\) strictly increasing or strictly decreasing? Give the reason.
(Kya \(y = (0.8)^{x}\) strictly increasing hai ya decreasing? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Strictly decreasing, kyun ke base \(0.8\) 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai: \((0.8)^{x_{2} - x_{1}} < 1\), is liye \((0.8)^{x_{2}} < (0.8)^{x_{1}}\).

book_ref.quote: is strictly decreasing when \(0 < a < 1\)

blocks.prompt:
25 Using the injectivity of the exponential function, solve \(5^{2x - 1} = 125\).
(Exponential function ke one-to-one hone se \(5^{2x - 1} = 125\) hal karein.)

book_ref.quote: is injective. It follows that any horizontal line meets the graph

blocks.prompt:
26 Define a horizontal asymptote of a function.
(Function ke horizontal asymptote ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ufqi line \(y = c\) \(y = f(x)\) ka horizontal asymptote hai agar \(x \to -\infty\) ya \(x \to \infty\) par \(f(x) \to c\); graph ka use chhoona zaroori nahi.

book_ref.quote: A horizontal asymptote is a horizontal line

blocks.prompt:
27 Define \(\sinh x\) and \(\cosh x\) and state their domains and ranges.
(\(\sinh x\) aur \(\cosh x\) ki definition, domain aur range likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sinh x = \frac{e^{x} - e^{-x}}{2}\): domain \(\mathbb{R}\), range \(\mathbb{R}\). \(\cosh x = \frac{e^{x} + e^{-x}}{2}\): domain \(\mathbb{R}\), range \([1, \infty)\).

book_ref.quote: The hyperbolic functions are defined as follows:

blocks.prompt:
28 Find \(\sinh(\ln 5)\) and \(\cosh(\ln 5)\), and verify \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) for \(x = \ln 5\).
(\(\sinh(\ln 5)\) aur \(\cosh(\ln 5)\) nikalein aur \(x = \ln 5\) ke liye \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) ki tasdeeq karein.)

book_ref.quote: Only two functions are really new

blocks.prompt:
29 Evaluate \(\tanh(\ln 3)\).
(\(\tanh(\ln 3)\) ki qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The other four are made from them exactly as in trigonometry

blocks.prompt:
30 Why are \(\coth x\) and \(\operatorname{csch} x\) not defined at \(x = 0\)?
(\(\coth x\) aur \(\operatorname{csch} x\) \(x = 0\) par defined kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Dono \(\sinh x\) se taqseem karte hain, aur \(\sinh x = 0\) sirf \(x = 0\) par. Is liye domain \(\mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\}\).

book_ref.quote: But \(\sinh x = 0\) only when

blocks.prompt:
31 Show that the point \((\cosh 2, \sinh 2)\) lies on the hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\).
(Dikhayein ke point \((\cosh 2, \sinh 2)\) hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) par hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cosh^{2} 2 - \sinh^{2} 2 = 1\) (identity \(t = 2\) ke saath), is liye point hyperbola par hai.

book_ref.quote: Hyperbolic functions are so named because

blocks.prompt:
32 Show that \(\cosh x + \sinh x = e^{x}\).
(Dikhayein ke \(\cosh x + \sinh x = e^{x}\).)

book_ref.quote: The other four are made from them exactly as in trigonometry

blocks.prompt:
33 Show that \(\sinh x\) is an odd function. What symmetry does its graph have?
(Dikhayein ke \(\sinh x\) odd function hai. Is ke graph ki symmetry kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sinh(-x) = -\frac{e^{x} - e^{-x}}{2} = -\sinh x\). Graph origin ke gird symmetric hai.

book_ref.quote: Such a function is called odd, and its graph is symmetric about the origin

blocks.prompt:
34 Show that \(\cosh x\) is an even function and explain why it is not one-to-one on \(\mathbb{R}\).
(Dikhayein ke \(\cosh x\) even function hai aur batayein ke yeh \(\mathbb{R}\) par one-to-one kyun nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cosh(-x) = \cosh x\). Maslan \(\cosh(-1) = \cosh 1\): do inputs, aik output, is liye one-to-one nahi.

book_ref.quote: Such a function is called even, and its graph is symmetric about the

blocks.prompt:
35 Show that \(\cosh x \ge 1\) for every real \(x\).
(Dikhayein ke har real \(x\) ke liye \(\cosh x \ge 1\).)
blocks.explanation: \(\left(e^{x/2} - e^{-x/2}\right)^{2} \ge 0\) se \(e^{x} + e^{-x} \ge 2\), yani \(\cosh x \ge 1\); barabari sirf \(x = 0\) par.

book_ref.quote: Why is 1 the smallest value?

blocks.prompt:
36 Find \(\sinh 1.5\) and \(\cosh 1.5\) correct to four decimal places.
(\(\sinh 1.5\) aur \(\cosh 1.5\) chaar decimal tak nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: To sketch the graph, we take a table of values

blocks.prompt:
37 State the domains of \(\tanh^{-1} x\) and \(\coth^{-1} x\), and their formulas.
(\(\tanh^{-1} x\) aur \(\coth^{-1} x\) ke domain aur formulas likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\tanh^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}\), domain \((-1, 1)\). \(\coth^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{x + 1}{x - 1}\), domain \((-\infty, -1) \cup (1, \infty)\).

book_ref.quote: The formulae, domains and ranges of all inverse hyperbolic functions are given

blocks.prompt:
38 Evaluate \(\tanh^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\).
(\(\tanh^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\) ki qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Why does \(\ln\) appear in every formula?

blocks.prompt:
39 Evaluate \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{5}\right)\) and \(\operatorname{csch}^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)\).
(\(\operatorname{sech}^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{5}\right)\) aur \(\operatorname{csch}^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: with mixed brackets that leave out 0

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is \(\cosh^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\) not defined?
(\(\cosh^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\) defined kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cosh^{-1} x\) ka domain \([1, \infty)\) hai kyun ke \(\cosh y \ge 1\). \(\frac{1}{2} < 1\), is liye koi real qeemat nahi.

book_ref.quote: no real value exists, because

blocks.prompt:
41 Use the formula to evaluate \(\sinh^{-1}\left(\frac{12}{5}\right)\).
(Formula se \(\sinh^{-1}\left(\frac{12}{5}\right)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Hence, its inverse function exists, and we define it as follows

blocks.prompt:
42 Use the formula to evaluate \(\cosh^{-1}\left(\frac{13}{5}\right)\).
(Formula se \(\cosh^{-1}\left(\frac{13}{5}\right)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the inverse hyperbolic cosine function exists

blocks.prompt:
43 Why is the domain of \(\cosh x\) restricted to \([0, \infty)\) before defining \(\cosh^{-1} x\)?
(\(\cosh^{-1} x\) se pehle \(\cosh x\) ka domain \([0, \infty)\) tak kyun mehdood kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbb{R}\) par line \(y = c > 1\) graph ko do dafa milti hai. \([0, \infty)\) par yeh one-to-one hai aur range \([1, \infty)\) wahi rehti hai, is liye bijective aur inverse mojood.

book_ref.quote: is not one-to-one on the domain

blocks.prompt:
44 Define the logarithmic function with base \(a\).
(Base \(a\) wale logarithmic function ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = \log_{a} x\), \(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\), \(x > 0\): har positive \(x\) ko woh wahid real \(y\) deta hai jis ke liye \(a^{y} = x\).

book_ref.quote: It assigns to each positive real number
A logarithm answers one question
raising the base to the logarithm of

blocks.prompt:
47 Simplify \(3\log 2 + \log 5 - \log 4\).
(\(3\log 2 + \log 5 - \log 4\) ko mukhtasar karein.)

book_ref.quote: we have studied the following laws of logarithms

blocks.prompt:
48 Use the change of base formula to find \(\log_{3} 10\) to four decimal places.
(Change of base formula se \(\log_{3} 10\) chaar decimal tak nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Why the change of base formula is useful

blocks.prompt:
49 Evaluate \(\log_{3} 54 - \log_{3} 2\).
(\(\log_{3} 54 - \log_{3} 2\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The quotient law is about

blocks.prompt:
50 Find the x-intercept and the asymptote of \(y = \log_{7} x\). Does it have a y-intercept?
(\(y = \log_{7} x\) ka x-intercept aur asymptote batayein. Kya is ka y-intercept hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 7^{0} = 1\): x-intercept \((1, 0)\). Vertical asymptote \(x = 0\). y-intercept nahi, kyun ke \(x = 0\) domain mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: is the vertical asymptote of

blocks.prompt:
51 Using the injectivity of \(\log_{3} x\), solve \(\log_{3}(2x + 1) = \log_{3}(x + 4)\).
(\(\log_{3} x\) ke one-to-one hone se \(\log_{3}(2x + 1) = \log_{3}(x + 4)\) hal karein.)

book_ref.quote: Hence, the logarithmic function is one to one.

blocks.prompt:
52 Find \(\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} \log_{1/3} x\) and explain it.
(\(\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} \log_{1/3} x\) nikalein aur wazahat karein.)

book_ref.quote: Hence \[\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = \infty\]

blocks.prompt:
53 Write five points for sketching \(y = \log_{5} x\).
(\(y = \log_{5} x\) banane ke liye paanch points likhein.)

book_ref.quote: the graph can be drawn accurately for different values of the base

blocks.prompt:
54 Define the modulus function and evaluate \(|-5| + |3| - |0|\).
(Modulus function ki definition likhein aur \(|-5| + |3| - |0|\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The modulus function or absolute value function is denoted and defined by:

blocks.prompt:
55 Describe the graph of \(y = |x|\): its shape, vertex and range.
(\(y = |x|\) ke graph ki shakal, vertex aur range batayein.)
blocks.explanation: V shakal: \(x < 0\) par \(y = -x\), \(x \ge 0\) par \(y = x\); vertex \((0, 0)\); range \([0, \infty[\).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the graph of modulus function can be sketched using the points

blocks.text: 1.8 Interpreting the Relation Between a One-to-One Function and Its Inverse through Graph

blocks.prompt:
56 When does a function have an inverse? Why is one-to-one enough when the co-domain is the range?
(Function ka inverse kab hota hai? Co-domain range ke barabar ho to sirf one-to-one kyun kaafi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inverse sirf bijective (one-to-one aur onto) function ka hota hai. Co-domain = range ho to har qeemat milti hai, function khud onto, sirf one-to-one shart baqi.

book_ref.quote: A function has an inverse only if it is bijective

blocks.prompt:
57 Find the inverse of \(f(x) = 4x - 1\) and show that \((2, 7)\) on \(f\) corresponds to \((7, 2)\) on \(f^{-1}\).
(\(f(x) = 4x - 1\) ka inverse nikalein aur dikhayein ke \(f\) par \((2, 7)\) ka jor \(f^{-1}\) par \((7, 2)\) hai.)

book_ref.quote: The graph of a function and its inverse are related through a geometric symmetry

blocks.text: 1.8.1 Method of Constructing the Graph of an Inverse Function

blocks.prompt:
58 Write the steps for constructing the graph of an inverse function.
(Inverse function ka graph banane ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) One-to-one function ka graph banayein. (2) Usi plane par line \(y = x\) banayein. (3) Graph ko \(y = x\) mein reflect karein. (4) Aks wala curve inverse ka graph hai.

book_ref.quote: The graph of an inverse function is obtained geometrically as follows:

blocks.prompt:
59 Reflect the points \((0, 1)\), \((1, 3)\), \((2, 9)\) of \(y = 3^{x}\) in \(y = x\). Which function's graph do the images lie on?
(\(y = 3^{x}\) ke points \((0, 1)\), \((1, 3)\), \((2, 9)\) ko \(y = x\) mein reflect karein. Aks kis function ke graph par hain?)

book_ref.quote: Why this is a true mirror image

blocks.prompt:
60 How is the graph of \(y = (x + 3)^{2} - 4\) obtained from \(y = x^{2}\)? Give its vertex.
(\(y = (x + 3)^{2} - 4\) ka graph \(y = x^{2}\) se kaise milta hai? Vertex batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(h = -3\), \(k = -4\): 3 units baayen aur 4 units neeche. Vertex \((-3, -4)\).

book_ref.quote: If both horizontal and vertical shifts are applied together

blocks.prompt:
61 Find the function obtained from \(f(x) = x^{3}\) by a horizontal stretch by factor 2.
(\(f(x) = x^{3}\) ko factor 2 se horizontal stretch karne se kaun sa function milta hai?)

book_ref.quote: then the graph is stretched horizontally by a factor

blocks.prompt:
62 Write the function obtained by shifting \(y = e^{x}\) 2 units to the right and then 3 units upward.
(\(y = e^{x}\) ko 2 units daayen aur phir 3 units ooper shift karne se function likhein.)

book_ref.quote: shift \(h\) units to the right

blocks.prompt:
63 State the effect on the graph of \(y = f(x)\) of (i) \(y = 5f(x)\) (ii) \(y = f\left(\frac{x}{4}\right)\).
(\(y = f(x)\) ke graph par asar batayein: (i) \(y = 5f(x)\) (ii) \(y = f\left(\frac{x}{4}\right)\).)
blocks.explanation: (i) Factor 5 se vertical stretch. (ii) \(b = \frac{1}{4}\): factor 4 se horizontal stretch.

book_ref.quote: Only the \(y\)-values of the graph change

blocks.prompt:
64 For \(f(x) = x^{2}\), compare (i) a vertical stretch by 2 followed by a shift 3 units down, with (ii) the shift 3 units down followed by the stretch by 2.
(\(f(x) = x^{2}\) ke liye mawazna karein: (i) factor 2 stretch phir 3 units neeche, (ii) pehle 3 units neeche phir factor 2 stretch.)

book_ref.quote: A vertical scaling done after a vertical shift scales the shift too

blocks.text: 1.10 Solving Problems Involving Exponential and Logarithmic Equations and Inequalities

book_ref.quote: write both sides as powers of the same base 2

blocks.prompt:
66 Solve \(3^{x} = 5\), giving the answer to four decimal places.
(\(3^{x} = 5\) hal karein, jawab chaar decimal tak.)

book_ref.quote: the bases 2 and 3 cannot be made equal

blocks.prompt:
67 Solve \(\log(x + 2) + \log(x - 1) = 1\).
(\(\log(x + 2) + \log(x - 1) = 1\) hal karein.)

book_ref.quote: The product law joined the logarithms into one

blocks.prompt:
68 Solve \(\log_{x} 49 = 2\).
(\(\log_{x} 49 = 2\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Base \(x > 0\), \(x \ne 1\). \(x^{2} = 49\), \(x = \pm 7\); \(-7\) base nahi ho sakta, is liye \(x = 7\).

book_ref.quote: here the unknown is also the base

blocks.prompt:
69 Solve the inequality \(3^{2x - 1} > 27\).
(Inequality \(3^{2x - 1} > 27\) hal karein.)

book_ref.quote: the logarithmic function with base 10 is strictly increasing, so the sign is kept

blocks.prompt:
70 Solve the inequality \((0.2)^{x} \le 25\).
(Inequality \((0.2)^{x} \le 25\) hal karein.)
